native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 'after first button press', 'state': {'servo1': '0°', 'servo2': '0°', 'servo3': '0°'}, 'description': 'Initial state after power-on/reset. All servos are at 0 degrees. The button is pressed once to transition from initial state to State 1 (which is also 0°,0°,0°).'}

test2: {'time': 'after second button press', 'state': {'servo1': '90°', 'servo2': '45°', 'servo3': '135°'}, 'description': 'State 2. After the second button press, servos move to: servo1=90°, servo2=45°, servo3=135°.'}

test3: {'time': 'after third button press', 'state': {'servo1': '180°', 'servo2': '90°', 'servo3': '0°'}, 'description': 'State 3. After the third button press, servos move to: servo1=180°, servo2=90°, servo3=0°.'}

test4: {'time': 'after fourth button press', 'state': {'servo1': '45°', 'servo2': '135°', 'servo3': '90°'}, 'description': 'State 4. After the fourth button press, servos move to: servo1=45°, servo2=135°, servo3=90°.'}

test5: {'time': 'after fifth button press', 'state': {'servo1': '0°', 'servo2': '0°', 'servo3': '0°'}, 'description': 'State 5. After the fifth button press, servos reset to initial positions: all at 0°. This corresponds to the reset state before cycling back to State 1.'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
